claim: For every exact n=3 relation, the compact and verbose packages select the identical normalized witness body.
corrected_semantic_contract: Path, relation direction, parent and child graphs, insertions, class, and unique transport semantics must agree exactly.
Each compact selected witness must be regenerated from the exact relation and must prove its claimed directed zero/nonzero or strict-sign property.
Each verbose selected witness must independently satisfy the same requirement on the same exact relation.
The compact and verbose packages need not choose the same valid separator when more than one exists.
mathematical_effect: None at this counterexample: both distinct witnesses independently certify the same strict separation.
audit_effect: The original lossless-body comparator is withdrawn and the full shards must be replayed under the corrected semantic-normalization contract.
